unexpected.USER: Something went wrong. Please try again later.
unexpected.SUPPORT: Record the error code and correlation ID; escalate if the issue persists.
unexpected.TECHNICIAN: Inspect redacted service telemetry, dependency health, and request timing.
unexpected.SUPERVISOR: Review the affected-user count and incident thresholds.

rate_limited.USER: Too many requests. Please try again later.
rate_limited.SUPPORT: Check the error code and retry window.
rate_limited.TECHNICIAN: Inspect quota scope and Retry-After; use bounded retries only for idempotent operations.
rate_limited.SUPERVISOR: Assess sustained rate limiting and customer impact.
rate_limited.ADMIN: Review approved rate-limit and capacity configuration.

unavailable.USER: The service is temporarily unavailable. Please try again shortly.
unavailable.SUPPORT: Include the correlation ID when escalating this dependency failure.
unavailable.TECHNICIAN: Inspect dependency health, timeout budget, and Retry-After.
unavailable.SUPERVISOR: Review service impact and escalation thresholds.
